tools.name: create_video
tools.description: Start a motion video from a public product URL or a prompt. Returns at once with status "queued"; poll get_video until it is "ready", then give the user video_url (needs the API key) or call share_video for a public link; poster_url is its cover image. Spends credits.

tools.name: get_video
tools.description: Status and links for one video. status is queued, running, ready or failed; revising is true while a revise runs.

tools.name: revise_video
tools.description: Change a ready video with a note, e.g. "make the headline shorter" or "use a darker background in the last scene". The earlier cut is kept as a version. Spends credits; poll get_video until revising is false.

tools.name: share_video
tools.description: Turn a public share link on (default) or off for a ready video. Anyone with share_url can watch without an account.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: The account's plan and available credits.
